# Agent Hatchers

> An Australian, founder-led AI studio. We hatch AI agents for businesses on Hermes — the client's own AI platform, where each agent owns one clear business job from request to finished deliverable: sales follow-up, document generation, invoice processing, website updates and more. One agent, job done. Clients talk to their agents in Slack or Microsoft Teams — both are supported and clients can switch between them at any time, since it is a setting rather than a rebuild — or in Hermes directly. Simple three-tier pricing: Basic at $10,000 then $499/month, Standard at $25,000 then $499/month with the agent marketplace to pick and hatch from, Premium bespoke from $50,000; or rent platform access for $949/month with no install fee and no agents included. AI usage is billed at cost through OpenRouter — clients pay per token used, not per seat, and can swap the underlying AI model with one click.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://agenthatchers.com/): The authoritative entry point — what we hatch, the interactive agent demo, how it works, and how to book.
- [How it works](https://agenthatchers.com/#hatchery): Three stages, egg to teammate — the client picks the job (one job per agent); we hatch the agent on Hermes, wired into their existing tools and taught their voice, in days not months; the agent joins their team in Slack or Microsoft Teams.
- [Watch Hatchy work](https://agenthatchers.com/#demo): Interactive replay of real Hatchy conversations inside Slack and Microsoft Teams — an @Hatchy mention from a human, then Hatchy reading the client's systems, showing its working, attaching finished deliverables, and pausing for approval before anything is sent. A Slack/Teams toggle replays the identical conversation in either app. Four agents shown: invoices, sales, documents, website. Includes one-click model swapping.
- [Agent library](https://agenthatchers.com/#agents): Ready-hatched agents (Sales, Document, Invoice, Support, Website) with the tools each connects to (HubSpot, Gmail, Notion, SharePoint, Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe, Zendesk, Outlook), custom agents quoted up front, and unlimited self-built agents included with every installation.
- [Comparison](https://agenthatchers.com/#compare): One table against ChatGPT and Claude — finished work in your tools vs answers; lives inside Slack & Teams vs its own app; knows your tone, templates and tools vs starting generic; pay per use at cost vs per-seat subscriptions; any model with one-click swapping vs single-vendor lock-in; installed and maintained for you vs on your own.
- [Security in plain English](https://agenthatchers.com/#security): Five plain-English guarantees — each client's Hermes runs on its own Linode server with files in the client's own Google Cloud storage bucket (encrypted in transit and at rest, handed back and wiped on exit), least-privilege per-agent access (one job, one set of keys), human approval before anything leaves the building, no customer data used for model training and OAuth rather than password sharing, and client-side revocation at any time with no exit fee.
- [Pricing](https://agenthatchers.com/pricing.html): Three tiers — Basic $10,000 then $499/month (own the platform, build unlimited agents); Standard $25,000 then $499/month (everything in Basic plus the agent marketplace to pick and hatch from — most popular); Premium from $50,000 (bespoke agents, deeper integrations). Or rent the platform for $949/month with no install fee, agents not included. AI usage billed at cost.

## Company
- [Team](https://agenthatchers.com/team.html): Founder-led — Hyein Yu (Founder, Head of Engineering) architects every installation; Noah Webb (Co-founder, CEO) runs every client relationship. Australian team, same-timezone delivery.
- [FAQ](https://agenthatchers.com/#faq): Authoritative answers on what Hermes is, what an agent is, pricing, why not just use ChatGPT or Claude, whether clients need to be technical (they do not), data safety and passwords (never asked for), and switching off or support.
- [Book a call](https://calendly.com/noah-automationbuilders/30min): 30-minute call — a live Hermes demo, a fit assessment, and a price on the spot.
